weather._note: Set to your coordinates. Weather comes from open-meteo.com, no API key.

apps.label: TV
apps._note: Everything that is watching-TV, behind one tile: live channels AND the on-demand library, addressed by channel number. Replaced the old separate STREAMING (jellyfin-mpv-shim) and LIVE TV tiles in July 2026 — phone-casting is gone, the remote drives everything now. $HTPC_DIR is the repo root, filled in by server.py, so no path is baked in. Channels in cabletv/channels.m3u, library index in cabletv/library.tsv, teletext on 990-999. Needs: apt install mpv. Prefer H.264 — the 3B+ has no HEVC hardware decoder.

apps.label: MUSIC
apps._note: A view inside the launcher page, not a process — so there is no launch and no black screen between the menu and the music screen. Shows what spotifyd is playing (MPRIS via playerctl) and offers prev/playpause/next. Playback is started from the Spotify app on your phone; this box is the Connect speaker. Needs: apt install playerctl, a spotifyd build with dbus_mpris, and use_mpris = true in spotifyd.conf.
